Maya (sales-eng): Quick triage needed - client (MediPlus) POC failing schema validation. They use function calls + strict JSON. Model returned a quoted JSON string inside an outer field and their validator rejects it. Also they hit 429s when running 5 parallel demo flows.

Ethan (engineer): Can you paste the request/response snippet? Which model and runtime?

Maya (sales-eng): Redacted request: POST /v1/generate { "model": "care-pro-1.1", "json_mode": "strict", "function_call": {"name":"export_note"} }
Response snippet: {"outer": "{\"note\": \"{\\\"id\\\": \\\"n_123\\\", \\\"text\\\": \\\"...\\\"}\"}" }

Ethan (engineer): Sounds like double-encoding. Short-term workarounds: 1) client-side unwrap + JSON.parse with try/catch; 2) set json_mode to "relaxed" for these calls; 3) pin to fncall-safe variant if available (care-pro-1.1-fncall-safe). Example helper: try { let p = resp.outer ? JSON.parse(resp.outer) : resp; if (typeof p.note === 'string') p.note = JSON.parse(p.note); } catch(e) { /* log + surface to support */ }

Priya (oncall): Edge logs show `edge-proxy: 429 throttle, pool=shared-hosted, qps=110, limit=80` during the demo ramp. I can request a presales quota bump or suggest Dedicated for predictable capacity.

Rita (security): They mentioned PHI in notes and asked about HIPAA/BAA. Hosted gives limited audit metadata (request_id + timestamp + truncated key). Dedicated/Private with VPC + BAA needed for stronger audit retention and KMS. Need retention days and whether exportable logs required.

Maya (sales-eng): They want per-call trace IDs, BAA, and a quote for a small dedicated pool (around 3 GPU equivalents).

Ethan (engineer): Action items: I'll reproduce the double-encoding against care-pro-1.1 and put together a tiny client patch to share. Also open bug if reproduces consistently.

Priya (oncall): Created capacity request CR-6019 and flagged presales-hipaa. I'll ask for a temporary demo bump to 180 qps for tomorrow's slot.

deploy-bot: capacity-request CR-6019 created by priya — status: pending.

Maya (sales-eng): I'll send the workaround + ask for dedicated quote. Thanks all :thumbsup:
